Impacts on the car floor and seam sealer crack. Front and rear shock absorbers. Front control arm ball joints and bushings. Tie rod ends. Rear axle bushings. Impact on the engine subframe. Impact, straightening, and cutting in the front right chassis support for bodywork. Impact on the front right metal fender liner from below. Oil evaporation from valve cover. Minor impact on the rear metal panel. Minor buckling in the front right chassis rail. Cut in exhaust insulator under the spare tire area. Impact on the engine skid plate. Cut in the door seals of the front left door and trunk.
